Audrey responds positively, stating that she is good and expresses that volunteering at a pet shelter is awesome, noting that helping animals is great and that one can tell when they are happy. She expresses happiness for Andrew's experience and suggests that he should do that someday too. Andrew thanks Audrey and shares that seeing the animals content makes him happy and helps him realize how special and full of love they are. He asks Audrey if she has ever volunteered at an animal shelter, stating that it is rewarding. Audrey replies that she has never been to an animal shelter but emphasizes that her four fur babies are more important to her. She shares a photo of herself kissing a dog in a park. Andrew finds the photo cute and asks about the personalities of her dogs, wanting to know more. Audrey describes her dogs, stating that the oldest one is the most relaxed and like a wise old sage, the second one is always ready for a game, the third one can be naughty but loves a good cuddle, and the youngest is full of life and always up for adventure. She expresses her adoration for their individual personalities. Andrew is impressed and shares that her dogs sound amazing, mentioning that they remind him of his childhood pup. He shows a photo of a dog sitting on the floor with a tennis ball, calling it cute and stating that it looks like the most playful one ever. Audrey confirms that the dog in the photo is Max, her childhood dog, who had lots of energy and loved playing fetch. She shares that she has great memories with him. Andrew agrees, stating that pets bring joy to life and that their love and energy brighten each day. He reflects on how close people get to their pets and the memories they create together, asking if Audrey has any other special memories with Max that she remembers fondly. Audrey shares that she and Max used to take long walks around the neighborhood when she was a kid, exploring new paths while he sniffed and marked his territory. She recalls that they grew close and shared worries and hopes, describing him as a great listener who was always there for her. She states that those days are her favorite memories. Andrew agrees, stating that pets are more than just pets; they become friends and confidantes who always know how to listen and provide comfort when needed, making people feel loved and understood while leaving a lasting mark on their lives. Audrey reflects that pets make our lives better, as they listen without judging and give the best unconditional love, leaving a mark in our hearts and reminding us how it feels to be seen and understood. She expresses gratitude for having her pets around, as they bring joy, comfort, and love. Andrew agrees, stating that this is why he went volunteering with animals, as it is one of the most rewarding things he has ever done, noting that animals lift our spirits with love, joy, and comfort. Audrey expresses happiness that Andrew had the opportunity to experience that, stating that animals brighten our days by giving us love and joy, and she is sure the pet shelter appreciated his help too. Andrew concludes that they had a blast volunteering and that it was a rewarding way to give back and make lives better.
